answer: Thirty berths open when the beacon sounds. Newcomers lock 90 POA for 3 epochs, then clear a trellis of three strangers in 20 minutes; each inspector stakes 10 POA, lost if their pass is convicted. The tundra test: a task seeded by a crystal drawn at start, unshareable. One operator covers at most two interviews live, so ten fakes need five hands and 30 interviews. Each extra identity from one root pays 35 POA more; ten fakes lock 2,475 POA, a miss burns 20 POA. The chain audits signatures, stakes, and roots: clones may pass tasks yet fail interviews, and a farm's horizon ends at its payroll.
